svg.title: Off-grid farming scene with birdbox sensor station, two test crop beds, a yellow campervan with a starlink dish, and a dachshund walking in the grass
svg.desc: Illustration of a solar-powered birdbox weather and soil sensor station on a stake, wired to two crop bed test plots, with a yellow campervan carrying a starlink dish and a brown dachshund walking on the grass nearby. Below, a vertical diagram shows data flowing from the sensors through an LSTM forecaster, an LLM planting scheduler, and an anomaly and inventory model, ending at the campervan dashboard.
